title: Beyond Action Prediction: Learning Search-Free Planning in Latent Space
abstract: arXiv:2610.23615v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent world models learn action-conditioned state transitions in a compact representation space, providing a predictive model for visual planning and control. However, planning with these models typically requires costly test-time optimization over action sequences. We propose to replace this online search with a goal-conditioned inverse model that directly predicts actions from current and goal observations. A key challenge is that action prediction alone neither ensures that goal representations encode action-relevant information nor that predicted actions are consistent with the learned latent prediction model. We introduce Hindsight Inverse JEPA Planning (HIJP), a search-free framework that addresses both aspects during training. HIJP relabels future observations along offline trajectories as goals, providing action supervision across multiple temporal horizons. translated_title: 超越动作预测：在潜在空间中学习无搜索规划
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型在紧凑的表示空间中学习动作条件下的状态转移，为视觉规划与控制提供预测模型。然而，使用这类模型进行规划通常需要对动作序列进行代价高昂的测试时优化。我们提出用目标条件逆模型来替代这种在线搜索，该模型直接从当前观测和目标观测预测动作。一个关键挑战在于：仅靠动作预测既无法保证目标表示编码了与动作相关的信息，也无法保证预测的动作与学习到的潜在预测模型保持一致。我们提出了后见逆JEPA规划（HIJP），这是一个在训练阶段同时解决上述两个问题的无搜索框架。HIJP将离线轨迹中的未来观测重新标记为目标，从而在多个时间尺度上提供动作监督。通过在目标表示中保留梯度，这种监督……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出HIJP框架，用目标条件逆模型直接从当前与目标观测预测动作，通过将轨迹未来观测重标记为多时间尺度的目标并保留梯度，实现无需测试时搜索的潜在空间规划。
